text: Coffee with Sofia after her shift. She's finally got the puppy, a cocker spaniel called Biscuit, and he's already eaten one of Stefan's trainers. They're taking him to puppy classes sometime next month. Must ask how the first class goes. Stefan, meanwhile, has taken up bouldering and keeps showing me videos of himself falling off walls. He wants to do a proper outdoor trip to the Peak District over the summer.

Pieter rang. His cat Nala's been off her food for a week, vet thinks it's her kidneys. Bloods are sometime next week and he's properly worried. Check in with him the day after. His partner Manon is away in Lyon for work most of that week, so he'll be on his own with it. Nala's sixteen, so he's bracing himself.

Long catch-up with Kiara. She's knitting a blanket for her sister's baby, due early March, and has already ripped it back twice. Her brother Rory is doing the Edinburgh marathon in the spring. She says he's barely training.
Kaito's band has a gig at the Crown end of the month. He's nervous, first time singing his own stuff. Text him good luck that afternoon and go along if I can.
Tendai says Leeds are definitely going up this year, which he says every year. He's got a season ticket now with his dad. Birthday's after Christmas, and a signed shirt would go down a storm.

Bumped into Nora and Leon at the market. They've booked Lisbon over the summer, two weeks. Leon's learning Portuguese on an app and is very proud of a 90 day streak. Nora is less keen on the flights, she hates flying, so they might get the train down through France instead. Her birthday falls while they're away and she's hinted that a nice linen beach bag would be ideal.
Layla's dog Pepper turns one on Saturday and she's genuinely throwing a party for it. Dog cake and everything. I'm bringing the bandanas.

Alejandro's chess club tournament got cancelled, venue flooded. He was gutted, had been prepping openings for weeks. Lola says he's now thinking about entering the online one instead, sometime in November.
Anders and his wife are expecting! Due in the spring. He also mentioned his mum is moving in with them for a bit after Christmas to help out, which he seems slightly nervous about.
Lachlan is coeliac, remember for the curry night. Also supports Celtic, do not mention the weekend.
Manon's pottery course finishes end of the month and there's a little exhibition the evening after. She's made about forty mugs, most of them wonky. Don't forget to go and buy one.
Pick up dog food and flea stuff before the weekend.
Mohammed got into the county cricket squad! Trials were a fortnight ago and he heard yesterday. First nets session is sometime in January. Send congrats.
Lindiwe's grandmother passed last week. The funeral is in Durban, she flies out Thursday and is back the week after. She's holding up but tired. Message her when she's home.
Chatted to Lena on the walk back. She's restoring an old Raleigh bike she found in a skip, spends every evening on it. Wants to ride the coast path in it over the summer with her partner Fern.
Lucy's rabbit Clover had an op on her teeth this morning. Lucy was a wreck beforehand. Ring her tonight to see how Clover's doing.
Yuki finished the 1000 piece puzzle of Mount Fuji. Took her four months. Her next one is 2000 pieces, which seems unhinged.
Leon's mum has her hip op early next month. He's taking a week off around it and staying with her afterwards. Ask him how she's getting on the week after.

Yara mentioned she's been really struggling since the breakup with Mustafa. She's thrown herself into climbing, three times a week at the wall, and wants to do an outdoor trip in the spring. Should invite her to the Sunday walk. Mustafa, for what it's worth, has moved back in with his parents in Leicester. Her sister Dalia is coming to stay sometime next week, which should help.
Dalia and Bogdan are getting a kitten! Picking her up the weekend after next. They can't agree on a name, he wants Pierogi, she wants Luna. Their flat's tiny so it'll be chaos.

Emeka's starting a new job at the BBC sometime in the new year, sound engineer. He's still in his old role till the end of November. Proper chuffed for him. He collects vinyl, mostly Afrobeat, and said a Fela reissue is the dream.
Carlos rang about the five-a-side. Final is Thursday week, he's captain and stressing about it. Demi says he's not sleeping. Wish him luck the night before.
Chioma's book club is doing Middlemarch this month. She's the only one who's finished it.
Olivia Wright texted, the housewarming's off because the sale fell through. She's gutted, they'd already packed. They're looking again sometime in the spring.

Had lunch with Pieter and Sofia. Pieter's been getting into birdwatching, bought proper binoculars and drags Sofia out to the marshes at dawn. Sofia's not convinced. They're off to Norfolk for a long weekend end of the month. Pieter's birthday is a week after they get back and he wants a bird book, the Collins one.
Stefan's daughter has her grade 5 piano exam sometime next week. She's terrified apparently, practises two hours a day. Stefan's more nervous than she is. Send her a good luck card the day before.
Kiara's dog Bruno has been limping since the walk on Sunday. Vet on Friday. Ask how it went afterwards.
Need to book the car in for its MOT end of the month, and sort my passport before spring.

Talked to Rory about his allotment. He's growing giant pumpkins for the village show next autumn, the current one's already massive. His wife Nora thinks he's lost the plot. Nora's own thing is sourdough, she's had the same starter for six years and named it Gerald.
Tendai mentioned his brother Kaito is moving to Manchester early next year for uni. Their mum's taking it hard. Kaito's into anime, especially Studio Ghibli.

Layla's off to Japan in the spring with her sister Yuki. Three weeks. She's planning it around the cherry blossom and wants to see a sumo tournament. Remind me to lend her my Tokyo guidebook before she goes.
Caught up with Alejandro. He's back playing guitar after ten years, flamenco mostly. Lessons on Wednesdays.
Lola's cat Mochi went missing on Monday. Still not back. She's put posters up everywhere and barely slept. Message her tomorrow morning to check in.
Anders and Lachlan are doing a charity cycle, London to Brighton, sometime in June. Lachlan's knee is still dodgy from rugby. Anders has been training on a turbo in his garage every night.

Manon's anniversary is next Friday, six years with Bogdan. She wants to surprise him with tickets to see Arctic Monkeys but they sold out in minutes. Said she'd take any gig really, he loves live music.
Mohammed's sister Lindiwe graduated on Tuesday, first class in architecture! Their whole family went up. He says she's starting at a firm in Bristol after Christmas. Need to send her a card.
Lena's guinea pigs are called Salt and Pepper. That's it, that's the note.
Lucy got the promotion, head of design from January. She said the interview went terribly so she's still in shock. Celebration drinks sometime next week, she'll let us know the date.

Fern was really quiet at the pub. Turns out her dad's been in hospital since the weekend, chest pains, they're doing more tests on Thursday. She's driving up to see him that morning. Text her on Thursday evening.
Leon and Yara's wedding is early September next year. He's already panicking about the speech. Venue's a barn in the Cotswolds.
Dalia is vegan now, and allergic to cashews, so no satay.
Mustafa got a puppy, a husky called Storm. Absolutely mental, chewed through a lead on day two. He's taking him to the vet for jabs next week and to the beach the weekend after.
Called Uncle Bogdan. His knee surgery's been pushed back to after Christmas, again. He's fed up but keeping busy with his model railway, he's building a whole Victorian station in the loft.
Emeka and Carlos are both obsessed with Elden Ring at the moment, they've been playing co-op every night. Carlos said he'd lend me his copy when he's done, sometime soon.

Demi's PhD viva is end of the month. She's not sleeping and has rewritten her opening slide nine times. Her supervisor Dr Novak says she's ready. Must message her the morning of, and take her for a drink a week after whatever happens.
Chioma's Nan turns ninety in early December. Big family do at a hotel, the weekend before. Chioma's making a photo album and asked if I've got any old pictures. Dig some out and send them over.

Olivia mentioned that her boss is retiring at Easter and she's been asked to apply for his job. She's unsure, worried about the hours with the kids. Interview would be sometime in February. Ask her about it after Christmas. Her husband Carlos thinks she should go for it. Their eldest starts nursery in the spring anyway, so the timing could actually work. Olivia's also been doing a lot of embroidery lately, she sells little hoops on Etsy.
Football tonight was miserable. Note to self, buy new shin pads.

Walked the dogs with Sofia and Kiara. Sofia's Biscuit is now the size of a small horse. Kiara's thinking of getting a second dog in the spring, a rescue greyhound. Her landlord's fine with it. Sofia's off to Kraków with Stefan sometime next month for his 40th.
Kaito Singh, Kai at work, plays drums in a jazz trio. Their next gig is at the Jazz Café, early March.
Pieter's son starts secondary school in September and they've just heard he got into the one they wanted. Big relief. Pieter's going to take him to the open evening the week after half term.
Stefan's mum's dog Monty had to be put to sleep on Sunday. Fourteen years. His mum's heartbroken, Stefan says she won't leave the house. Should take her some flowers sometime this week.
Rory's daughter Lola has her first ballet show the Saturday after next. She's got a tiny solo and is beyond excited. Rory asked if I'd come, I said yes. Bring flowers for her afterwards.

Tendai's off to Zimbabwe over Christmas to see his grandparents, first time in eight years. Flying out on the 18th, back sometime early January. He's a bit nervous about how much they'll have aged. His mum is going out a week earlier to help get the house ready. He asked if I'd feed his tortoise, Ziggy, while he's away. Need to get the spare key off him the day before he flies.

Caught up with Lachlan about his D&D campaign. He's DM, they've been going two years. Session every other Friday. He's now painting all the miniatures himself and wants a proper paint set for his birthday, end of the month.
Yuki says her parrot Kiwi learned to say her boyfriend's name, Leon, but not hers. Leon finds this hilarious. Kiwi's twenty, older than their relationship.
Nora's hosting Christmas this year for the first time, twelve people, and she's already stressed. Her in-laws are coming the day before and staying till the 28th. I should offer to bring dessert.
Lindiwe has her driving test the Monday after next. Third attempt. She's very anxious and doesn't want anyone to mention it beforehand. Ask her how it went the day after.

Mohammed and Yara were arguing about whether Arsenal will win the league. Yara's a season ticket holder, Mohammed's a Spurs fan. Doomed friendship. They're both going to the north London derby in the spring, sitting in opposite ends. Yara said she'd buy him a pint afterwards if Arsenal win, which feels unlikely to end well. Mohammed's wife Chioma has refused to go.

Lucy's cat Pickle turned fifteen yesterday. She had a little cake made from tuna. Also her mum is coming to stay for a fortnight sometime in November, and Lucy is dreading it. Pop round with wine one evening while she's there.
